Here you go — I fixed the grammar but kept your voice, your humor, and your heart in it. This should work for email and group text (paste it right in, no fancy formatting needed).

---

**Lotus Glow Nails — We Will Be Back! (A Car Came for a Pedicure 😄)**

Dear friends, family, church family, and my lovely ladies who have been coming to me for a long time,

I have to tell you something a little scary and a lot funny. But everybody is OK, so please do not worry.

Last night, Sunday Nov 8, around 2am, a lady drove her car straight through my salon front window on Bellaire Blvd. I have had this shop 11 years, and this is how it crash. Nobody was inside — the car was empty. The driver is OK, the police came, and her insurance is paying. That is the most important part.

The front glass is gone and my pedicure chair is smashed. The city inspector has to come check the wall before I can open again. The contractor says we can open **Monday, November 16**. Please come back that day and give me a hug and your feet. 😄

**This week:** me, Trang, and Kim are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, **Pearland Nail Bar**. If you need your nails done before we open, please call or text my cell: **832-555-0147**. We will take good care of you there.

Now let me tell you the funny part, because I cannot laugh by myself:

- The floor look like rainbow throw up, all the colors. My husband say, "Finally! The shop is modern art now."
- The car stop exactly at the pedicure chair. Like she come for a spa.
- My daughter say the driver get the **first drive-thru pedicure in Houston**.

Ha ha ha. For one hour that car was my best customer.

I am OK. I cry a little bit in the morning, but now I am fine. God protect my family, because nobody was inside that car. That is all I want to say about that.

**If you have a gift card from Lotus Glow Nails, it is still good. Nobody lose their money.** When we open again, everybody come get their nails done — I will make it worth the wait.

Thank you all for the text and for the food. Mrs. Dung, you bring pho this morning and you make me cry again (the good kind). Thank you, my friends. You are the best people.

Please pass this message along to everybody. Lotus Glow Nails is coming back, and we miss you!

Love,
**[Your name]**
Lotus Glow Nails — 11 years on Bellaire Blvd

---

**Two quick things before you send it:**
1. Put your first name at the bottom (and maybe your salon phone if you have one, so people can call the shop line too).
2. Double-check the November 16 date with your contractor and the inspector — if the city pushes it, change that one line and everything else still works.

Want me to make a much shorter 4-line version too, just for the group text, so people can read it fast and know where to go this week?
